category: dependency ordering (a repeated edge is counted more times than it is cleared); 4 packages, 29 files, two-file defect
issue: Declaring the same upstream job twice hangs the run. In our nightly pipeline one job waits for ["@build", "compile"], and the build group already contains compile. Every upstream job succeeds, but the run then aborts with "ScheduleError: no runnable jobs but 2 still pending" and the job that named compile twice never starts. Deleting the redundant entry from the spec makes the very same pipeline run to the end, so a repeated dependency seems to be counted more times than it is ever cleared.
